verses.text: A Psalm of David. Ascribe to YHWH, O sons of the mighty ones. Ascribe to YHWH glory and strength.

segments.text: A Psalm of David. Ascribe to YHWH, O sons of the mighty ones. Ascribe to YHWH glory and strength.

verses.text: Ascribe to YHWH the glory of His name; bow down before YHWH in the splendor of holiness.

segments.text: Ascribe to YHWH the glory of His name; bow down before YHWH in the splendor of holiness.

verses.text: The voice of YHWH [is] upon the waters; the God of glory thunders—YHWH [is] over many waters.

segments.text: The voice of YHWH [is] upon the waters; the God of glory thunders—YHWH [is] over many waters.

verses.text: The voice of YHWH [is] with power, the voice of YHWH [is] with majesty.

segments.text: The voice of YHWH [is] with power, the voice of YHWH [is] with majesty.

verses.text: The voice of YHWH breaks the cedars, and YHWH shatters the cedars of Lebanon.

segments.text: The voice of YHWH breaks the cedars, and YHWH shatters the cedars of Lebanon.

verses.text: He makes Lebanon skip like a calf, and Sirion like the son of a wild ox.

segments.text: He makes Lebanon skip like a calf, and Sirion like the son of a wild ox.

verses.text: The voice of YHWH is hewing flames of fire.

segments.text: The voice of YHWH is hewing flames of fire.

verses.text: The voice of YHWH causes the wilderness to writhe; YHWH causes the wilderness of Kadesh to writhe.

segments.text: The voice of YHWH causes the wilderness to writhe; YHWH causes the wilderness of Kadesh to writhe.

verses.text: The voice of YHWH twists the oaks, and strips bare the forests—and in His temple all of it is saying, “Glory!”

segments.text: The voice of YHWH twists the oaks, and strips bare the forests—and in His temple all of it is saying, “Glory!”

verses.text: YHWH has sat over the flood, and YHWH sits as King forever.

segments.text: YHWH has sat over the flood, and YHWH sits as King forever.

verses.text: YHWH gives strength to His people; YHWH blesses His people with peace.

segments.text: YHWH gives strength to His people; YHWH blesses His people with peace.
